title: Each isolation layer is also a log source - the SIEM is what turns three silent gates into one visible story

children.title: Identity Proxy
lines: Every request already carries a verified identity (X-App-ID) - log denied auth attempts + which workspace served which request

children.title: VLAN / ipvlan
lines: A packet with the wrong VLAN tag trying to reach another tenant's segment is a real signal - an IDS - OSS: Suricata per VLAN; AWS: GuardDuty

children.title: gVisor sandbox
lines: Every syscall the Sentry emulates is visible in-process - an eBPF sensor watching the sandbox catches anomalous syscall - OSS: Falco; AWS: GuardDuty

children.title: Correlation (the SIEM core)
lines: same workspace_id / owner attribution across all three sources - 3 unrelated-looking events become 1 incident

children.title: One risk-ranked incident:
lines: "workspace X - proxy denial, then a VLAN-102 IDS hit, then an anomalous syscall in the same sandbox, within 3 seconds"
